title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AS AUTOMATED ALIGNERS FOR BENCHMARKING VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper explicitly introduces "Value Alignment" as one of its four core evaluation dimensions for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). This dimension focuses on aligning model behaviors with human values, ethics, and norms, including the refusal to generate harmful or unethical responses. It includes sub-skills such as "Privacy" and "Security" in its benchmark and provides examples where models are evaluated on their ability to adhere to ethical guidelines and avoid making inappropriate judgments about individuals.
